Claim c1:
Source 1: newsonair.gov.in, सरकार ने मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना का दावा करने वाले एक वीडियो का खंडन किया | आकाशवाणी न्यूज़, The government has refuted a video circulating on YouTube that claims the government is providing free laptops or financial assistance of ₹25,000 to all students under the PM Laptop Scheme 2026. The Press Information Bureau's (PIB) fact-check unit stated that the claim made in the video is fake and that the central government is not currently running any such scheme. [1]
Source 2: newsonair.gov.in, सरकार ने छात्र लैपटॉप योजना 2026 के अंतर्गत मुफ्त लैपटॉप वितरण के संदेश का खंडन किया | आकाशवाणी न्यूज़, The government has refuted a message circulating on social media that claimed the government is providing free laptops under the Student Laptop Scheme 2026. The PIB fact-check unit stated that this claim is fake and part of a scam, and that no such scheme has been announced by the government. [2]
Source 3: abplive.com, PIB Fact Check: क्या केंद्र सरकार छात्रों को फ्री लैपटॉप दे रही है? जानें वायरल मैसेज का सच, August 11 2026, According to PIB, the Government of India or the Ministry of Education has not announced any such scheme to provide free laptops to students. The viral message claiming this is not true, and the logos, format, and links used in it are fake. [3]
Source 4: livehindustan.com, क्या छात्रों को मुफ्त में मिलेगा लैपटॉप, केंद्र सरकार लेकर आई योजना? जानें वायरल दावे का सच, December 16 2024, A YouTube video thumbnail claiming that the Indian government has launched the PM Free Laptop Scheme 2024 to offer free laptops to students is viral. People are questioning if such a scheme exists, and if the central government has indeed introduced a free laptop distribution scheme. [4]
Source 5: buddy4study.com, Free Laptop Scheme 2026-27 – List of Schemes, Eligibility & More, August 25 2026, This article discusses various state-level free laptop schemes for students in India for 2026-27, such as the Tamil Nadu Government's Ulagam Ungal Kaiyil scheme, which has a budget of ₹2,000 crore and aims to cover 10 lakh students. It also mentions that eligibility criteria and required documents differ from state to state. [5]
Source 6: schemesinindia.in, UP Free Laptop Yojana — Uttar Pradesh 2026, September 06 2026, The Uttar Pradesh government distributes free laptops and tablets to meritorious students who passed Class 10 and Class 12 from the UP Board to promote digital education. Eligible students are distributed laptops/tablets through their schools after registration on digishakti.up.gov.in. [6]

Claim c2:
Source 1: taazarozgar.com, (No title), September 20 2026, This source mentions that to apply for the Yojana, one must use a secure online application link, and that the article will help understand the entire process in simple steps. It does not mention any specific last date for application. [7]
Source 2: laptopyojana.in, (No title), September 27 2026, This source lists required documents for a laptop scheme, including Aadhaar card, passport-size photos, mobile number, email ID, 10th/12th mark sheets, bonafide certificate, domicile certificate, caste certificate, and income/bank details. It does not mention any application deadline. [8]
Source 3: youtube.com, (No title), July 29 2026, This YouTube video discusses various scholarships and their deadlines, mentioning "last date 8 August" for one and "last date 30 July" for another, but it does not specifically refer to the "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026" or an October 15 deadline for it. [9]
Source 4: youtube.com, CM Punjab Laptop Scheme 2026 Apply Online | How to Apply for Laptop Scheme 2026 | CM Laptop Scheme, February 21 2026, This video discusses the CM Punjab Laptop Scheme 2026 and its eligibility criteria and application process, but it does not mention a Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026 or an October 15 application deadline. [10]
Source 5: facebook.com, (No title), October 04 2026, This Facebook post discusses a "Free Laptop Scheme 2026" and advises viewers to check official government portals for the latest information on eligibility, benefits, application process, and selection rules, as these may vary by state government or scheme. It does not mention a specific application deadline of October 15. [11]
Source 6: buddy4study.com, Free Laptop Scheme 2026-27 – List of Schemes, Eligibility & More, August 25 2026, This article discusses various state-level free laptop schemes and their eligibility, but it does not mention a specific application deadline of October 15 for a "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026." [5]

Source 5: facebook.com, (No title), October 04 2026, This Facebook post advises checking official government portals for the latest information on free laptop schemes, but it does not endorse "www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in" as an official website. [11]
